title: e-Urząd
testedEzd: The API key works; signed in as {user}.
neverSynced: Nothing saved yet. Refresh reads the office now; the agent can also run e-urzad … sync.
ezdNote: Reads only. Registering mail, adding files to a case and outgoing mail require a matching approval in Approvals.
edNote: Listing reads metadata only: nothing here opens a delivery. Opening one (which can make it legally delivered) and sending wait for your approval in Approvals.
noCases: No cases in progress, or none read yet.
noTasks: No tasks, or none read yet.
noDeliveries: No deliveries, or none read yet.
proofNote: Evidence the operator issued (A.1 accepted for sending, E.1 delivered, BP.* proofs of sending and receipt), saved beside its delivery. A send answer alone proves nothing.
